bagPolicy.summary: Bowery Ballroom does not publish a bag size limit. All bags are searched at entry.
bagPolicy.note: Coat check runs during colder months at $3 per item.

parking.summary: The venue has no designated parking and points visitors to neighborhood street parking and the subway.
parking.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

rideshare.summary: Concerto couldn't find a rideshare pickup zone published by Bowery Ballroom. Set your pickup to the venue's address. After the show, use any signed pickup area, or walk a block or two from the main exit before you request a ride so your driver can reach you.

concessions.summary: The club sells light snacks and has a full bar with water, soft drinks, beer, wine and spirits. All bar and box-office sales accept debit or credit only; staff can exchange cash for a prepaid card without a fee.
concessions.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

accessibility.summary: Bowery Ballroom provides reasonable accommodations for patrons with disabilities, including a limited number of reserved seats. Reserved seats are held for 30 minutes after the ticketed start time.

reEntry.summary: The Bowery Ballroom does not allow re-entry; the designated smoking section is an exception.
reEntry.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

ticketPickup.summary: Tickets are sold through Ticketmaster from each show page. If a show doesn't sell out in advance, tickets are sold at the door that night, and you can scan your ticket from your phone with the Ticketmaster app.

gates.summary: The venue advises arriving near the advertised door time; shows generally begin about an hour after doors, but check the individual event.
gates.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.
